authority: Bounded execution worker. Read-only on all pinned/canonical paths. No gate verdict, no node transition, no validation_status=passed, no coverage count claim. This is an instrument-divergence measurement, not a binding table; REC-39/REC-36 owners keep the decision.
question: REC-39 / CF-31 records that the controller hash scan (reported 4 full accepts at F2b pin b2ab6acb2bbe) and the formulation lead's per-file census (0 accept / 7 revise at the same pin) share no accept reviewer, and that at least one method is wrong. This run asks mechanically: which selection terms (corpus, target normalization, flag default, verdict freshness) separate the two reported suites, and are the counts reproducible from current bytes?

formulation_lead_census_01_13_00.reported: F2b 0 accept / 7 revise (worker-066 x2, worker-035, worker-017, worker-075, worker-018, worker-053)

corpora.stream: research_map/events.jsonl lines with event_type=review and created_at >= 2026-09-12T00:50, whose target string mentions F2b; plus the F2b review events' verdicts

terms.T_exact_alias: the record's target_id / target / target_subnode normalizes via the live TARGET_ALIASES map to exactly 'F2b' (controller predicate term)
terms.T_node_or_name: node_id == 'F2b' OR 'F2b' in filename OR target string contains 'F2b' (a lead-like selection term; reconstructed, not claimed to be the lead's code)
terms.B_pin: at least one explicit pin field (artifact_sha256, reviewed_sha256, sha256, cited_sha256, target.sha256, artifact.sha256, target.artifact_sha256, artifact.reviewed_sha256) shares a 12-hex prefix with the live F2b pin
terms.V: verdict lowercased in {accept, revise, reject, inconclusive}
terms.mutation: |mtime - created_at| > 60 s, or created_at absent, or created_at future-dated relative to harvest wall clock

confirmatory_measurements: M1: re-implement the controller predicate from research_map/astra_lifecycle.py::review_coverage source and compare it to the live function's own output on the same F2b snapshot (exact-match control).
M2: per-record term matrix over every reviews/*.json record that mentions F2b in filename, node_id, target fields, or raw text; report which records each predicate selects.
M3: reproduce from current bytes the 01:16:26 controller suite (3 full accepts) and test whether the 01:12:39 suite (4 full accepts) is reproducible; attribute any difference to a named file/term.

M4: stream-corpus census: count F2b review events by target-string class (exact 'F2b' vs variant containing F2b) and verdict, and list the variant target strings that the controller's exact-alias term cannot see.
M5: mutation census over the live-pin F2b disk records, including the same-filename accept->revise flip of F2b-review-worker-072-rev29.json between the two controller reports.
M6: digest of the confirmatory result set; re-run must reproduce it on the same snapshots.
classification_rule: A record is selected by a predicate iff all of its terms hold. The decisive term for each suite difference is reported per record; no predicate is declared correct. 'Correct count' adjudication belongs to astra-life05-verify-gform-r3.
controls: K1 synthetic: exact-alias target + pin match + accept + flag absent -> controller term true, strict term false
K2 synthetic: target string 'F2b-accept-set@<pin>' -> exact-alias term false, contains-F2b term true
K3 synthetic: pin mismatch -> B_pin false under both
K4 synthetic: reviewer node_id F2b but target_id None -> exact-alias false, node-or-name true
K5 synthetic: created_at 600 s before mtime -> mutation detector true
K6 determinism: two runs of the same extraction produce identical digest
K7 live controller function vs re-implementation exact match on the snapshot
K8 pre/post: every harvested file sha256 unchanged at end of run, else snapshot voided
falsifier: Falsified if (a) my re-implementation of the controller predicate disagrees with astra_lifecycle.review_coverage output on the same snapshot; (b) any record claimed invisible to the exact-alias term is shown to normalize to 'F2b' under the live TARGET_ALIASES map; (c) the 01:12:39 accept entry for F2b-review-worker-072-rev29.json is not present in the cited hash-pinned controller report; (d) the digest is not reproducible in a second run on the same bytes; (e) any harvested F2b review file changes sha256 between harvest and end-of-run (snapshot measurement void, mutation finding survives); (f) the mutation list contains a file whose |mtime-created_at|<=60 s and has a created_at.
non_claims: not a G-FORM gate verdict and not a node verdict
not a binding coverage table and not a claim about which reported count is correct
no write to any schema, review, ledger, taxonomy, map, or pinned path
the stream-corpus predicate is a reconstruction for divergence attribution, not the lead's published code
